title: Greenland and Denmark set for anti-Trump protests – Europe live
summary: ‘Hands off Greenland’ rallies have been organised in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Aalborg, Odense and Nuuk European leaders spent the past year treading carefully around Donald Trump as he levied tariffs , pushed Nato countries to increase their defence spending to 5% of GDP and threatened to pull US support from Ukraine . But Trump’s plans to seize control of Greenland “may force Europe to draw a line in the snow”, writes The Guardian’s Andrew Roth and Jennifer Rankin. Continue reading...
